UK legal practice · East London

Clear legal advice for individuals, families and businesses.

Confidère Legal is led by Managing Partner Sajid Mahmood, a solicitor with more than fifteen years’ experience in private practice and local government. We advise on family, immigration, criminal defence, licensing and housing matters, and give businesses senior support on data protection, privacy and AI governance.

For individuals and families

How we can help

View all services
  1. 01 Family Law Divorce and separation, finances, children and protection orders, with clear advice at every stage.
  2. 02 Immigration UK visas, sponsor licences, settlement, citizenship and appeals, from first application to tribunal.
  3. 03 Criminal Defence From police station advice through to trial, including prosecutions brought by local authorities.
  4. 04 Licensing and Regulatory Premises, taxi and private hire licensing, hearings and appeals, for applicants and licensing authorities.
  5. 05 Property and Housing First-tier Tribunal appeals, local authority enforcement, and landlord and tenant matters.
For businesses

Technology, Data and AI Governance

Senior data protection, privacy and AI governance support for UK businesses, without the cost of a full-time hire.

Explore business services Book a data protection health check
i.

Fractional Data Protection Officer

A named adviser for a set number of hours each month: DPO appointment, advisory support, request and complaint triage, and board reporting.

ii.

Data protection and privacy

Health checks, gap assessments, data mapping, records of processing, DPIAs, privacy notices, cookie compliance and breach response planning.

iii.

AI governance and compliance

AI use case intake, system inventories, risk classification, AI impact and vendor risk assessments, and governance frameworks.

iv.

Cyber assurance and technology contracts

Security and privacy assurance, and SaaS, cloud, outsourcing, licence and data processing agreements, NDAs and AI terms of use.

How we work with you

One named solicitor, a clear price, and advice without jargon.

  1. Step 01

    First conversation

    We listen, explain your options and tell you what it will cost.

  2. Step 02

    Clear proposal

    A fixed fee or estimate in writing, with what is and is not included.

  3. Step 03

    Action

    Practical advice, documents and representation, explained in plain English.

  4. Step 04

    Support to the end

    The same named solicitor stays with your matter from start to finish.

Our team

Small by design. You deal directly with a senior solicitor.
